## Summary

- What changed?
- Why now?

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (e.g. `feat(chat): ...`)
- [ ] Commits are semantic and lint-clean
- [ ] Docs/design docs are updated when architecture or behavior changed
- [ ] `changelogs/` updated when user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] Postmortem added/updated when incident or structural gap was found
